ico.title: IČO
ico.description: Czech company identification number, 8 digits (the mod-11 checksum is verified).

websiteUrl.title: Company website
websiteUrl.description: Home page of the company. The Actor reads the home page, /kontakt and /obchodni-podminky.

checkMaps.title: Check Google Maps
checkMaps.description: Look up the company's Google Maps place (one capped run of compass/crawler-google-places, about $0.004 per place).

companyName.title: Company name for the Google Maps search
companyName.description: Name to search on Google Maps. Empty = the website domain.

city.title: City
city.description: City for the Google Maps search.

maxPlaces.title: Max Google Maps places
maxPlaces.description: Cap on places crawled for the search (cost control).
